jobs.title: Mid-Wife (Rapid recruitment)
jobs.description:
**Position:** Mid-Wife

**Job Location:** Jordan, Mafraq

**Reporting to:** General Practitioner

**Working area:** Mafraq – Zaa’atri camp

**Number of positions open:** 1

**Last date for application:** November 12, 2026

## Key relationships:

SAMS Za’atari Medical Center Staff.

## Purpose of Assignment

The Midwife at SAMS Medical Center in Zaatari Refugee Camp is responsible for providing safe, respectful, evidence-based, and high-quality maternal and reproductive health services to women and adolescent girls, in accordance with Jordanian national health protocols, established clinical guidelines, and SAMS policies and procedures.

The Midwife provides care throughout pregnancy and the postnatal period, including antenatal assessments, maternal and newborn health education, counseling, identification of pregnancy-related risk factors, early recognition of complications, and timely referral to appropriate healthcare facilities. The role contributes to improving access to essential maternal and reproductive healthcare services for Syrian refugees and other eligible beneficiaries in Zaatari Camp.

The position underlines woman-centered care, confidentiality, dignity, informed consent, cultural sensitivity, and equitable access to healthcare. The Midwife also contributes to health promotion, accurate medical documentation, continuity of care, infection prevention and control, and effective coordination with the multidisciplinary healthcare team.

## **Scope of Work**

The Midwife works as an integral member of the multidisciplinary healthcare team at SAMS Medical Center, coordinating with physicians, nurses, psychosocial support team , and other relevant healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and continuous maternal and reproductive healthcare.

The position is responsible for delivering clinical services within the limits of professional competence and authorized scope of practice, maintaining accurate and confidential medical records, following established referral pathways, and implementing SAMS clinical protocols and women-friendly service principles.

The Midwife reports directly to the Medical Center Manager and seeks clinical guidance or supervision from the designated medical or maternal health supervisor, as applicable. The role also supports community health awareness, quality improvement initiatives, and the identification of barriers affecting access to maternal health services.

## Main tasks and responsibilities:

1. Conduct antenatal assessments and scheduled follow-ups, monitor maternal health and pregnancy progress, identify risk factors, and update individualized care plans.
2. Monitor vital signs, conduct routine maternal health screenings, follow up on required laboratory tests, ensure results are reviewed by the responsible physician, and coordinate necessary appointments and referrals.
3. Identify high-risk pregnancies, obstetric emergencies, and maternal or newborn danger signs; provide initial care within the authorized scope of practice and arrange timely referral to the appropriate healthcare provider.
4. Provide health education and counseling on healthy pregnancy practices, nutrition, danger signs, prescribed medications and supplements, preconception care, childbirth preparation, and the importance of regular antenatal visits.
5. Provide postnatal care and follow-up, support breastfeeding, educate caregivers on essential newborn care and immunization, and identify complications requiring medical assessment or referral.
6. Provide reproductive health and family planning counseling, dispense approved contraceptive methods and supplies within the authorized scope of practice, promote healthy birth spacing, and maintain accurate dispensing and stock records.
7. Administer routine vaccinations to infants under 18 months in accordance with the Jordanian national immunization schedule and approved protocols, ensuring proper vaccine handling, cold chain maintenance, documentation, and follow-up of missed doses.
8. Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential medical records, including clinical assessments, laboratory results, care plans, referrals, immunization records, follow-up outcomes, and periodic service reports.
9. Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control standards, patient safety measures, informed consent, confidentiality, safeguarding principles, and respectful, culturally sensitive, and non-discriminatory care.
10. Coordinate with the multidisciplinary healthcare team to ensure continuity of care, timely specialist referrals, and appropriate follow-up.
11. Participate in community health education, clinical meetings, training, quality improvement activities, and other relevant duties assigned by the supervisor.

## **Qualifications and Knowledge**

The candidate must demonstrate proficient knowledge in the following areas:

1. Bachelor's degree in Midwifery.
2. A minimum of 3 years of experience is preferred with international or national non–governmental organizations.
3. Recognized qualification in midwifery with valid professional registration or licensure in accordance with Jordanian regulations.
4. Strong knowledge of maternal, newborn, and reproductive health, Family planning antenatal and postnatal care protocol, including anatomy, physiology, pregnancy-related changes, and common obstetric and postpartum complications.
5. Knowledge of infection prevention and control, medication safety, and safe clinical practices within the scope of professional practice.
6. Knowledge of the Jordanian national immunization schedule for children under 18 months.
7. Understanding of patient confidentiality, informed consent, safeguarding, and respectful, women-centered care.
8. Familiarity with Jordanian Ministry of Health guidelines and the national healthcare system.
9. Previous experience in primary healthcare, humanitarian health programs, or refugee settings is an advantage.

## **Skills and Competencies**

The candidate must demonstrate the following skills and competencies:

1. Strong clinical assessment, decision-making, and patient care skills within the scope of midwifery practice.
2. Excellent communication, counseling, and interpersonal skills to build trust with women and their families.
3. Effective teamwork and coordination within a multidisciplinary healthcare setting.
4. Compassionate, culturally sensitive, and non-discriminatory care, respecting patient dignity and confidentiality.
5. Strong organizational skills, with accuracy in clinical documentation, reporting, and patient follow-up.
6. Ability to recognize complications, respond promptly, and initiate appropriate referrals in accordance with approved clinical protocols.
7. Commitment to patient safety, professional ethics, safeguarding, and infection prevention and control.
8. Ability to adapt and work effectively in humanitarian settings with limited resources and diverse beneficiary needs.
9. Basic computer skills and proficiency in maintaining paper-based or electronic medical records.
10. Commitment to SAMS policies, procedures, professional conduct standards, and dress code.

## Languages

- Excellent written and spoken in Arabic
- Excellent written and spoken English

### Safeguarding policy:

As SAMS representatives, we have a duty to protect all program participants from harm, and to pay particular attention to the specific needs of vulnerable individuals within affected populations. As a humanitarian organization that is entrusted with the care of vulnerable children and adults, SAMS has zero tolerance for any form of exploitation and abuse that is perpetrated by its representatives. SAMS is committed to safeguarding all program participants from harm, and will take all necessary action to respond to allegations of sexual exploitation and abuse (SEA), while adopting a survivor-centered approach. Similarly, SAMS will take all necessary action to respond to allegations of harassment, bullying, discrimination, and sexual harassment within the workplace. There are several channels through which to report safeguarding concerns to SAMS in confidence, including an option to report concerns anonymously in English or Arabic via the SAMS website. Other reporting channels include speaking with a trained safeguarding focal point in your office, or emailing psea@sams-usa.net.

jobs.title: Responsable Logistique Pays Côtiers (H / F)
jobs.description:
Vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté de la logistique, doté d’un leadership reconnu et capable de piloter la performance, de coordonner des équipes et de développer des synergies entre plusieurs pays ? Rejoignez Humanité & Inclusion et contribuez à renforcer l’efficacité et la qualité de nos opérations au service des personnes en situation de handicap et des populations vulnérables !

**Contexte et enjeux du poste :**

Humanité & Inclusion | Handicap International (HI), organisation de solidarité internationale à but non lucratif, met en œuvre des actions humanitaires et de développement visant à améliorer l’accès aux services essentiels, renforcer la résilience des communautés et promouvoir l’inclusion. Les interventions de HI s’articulent autour de plusieurs axes : réadaptation physique et fonctionnelle, santé mentale et soutien psychosocial, éducation inclusive, protection, sécurité alimentaire et moyens de subsistance, réduction des risques liés aux engins explosifs, de transformation de conflit ainsi que le plaidoyer en faveur des droits des personnes en situation de handicap. L’approche de HI repose sur la participation des communautés, la promotion du « do no harm » et la recherche d’un impact durable au service de la dignité humaine.

Depuis 1 an, HI a engagé un processus de régionalisation et de décentralisation de sa gouvernance opérationnelle, visant à rapprocher la prise de décision des réalités locales. Cette évolution s’accompagne d’une mutualisation renforcée des ressources, d’une harmonisation des pratiques et d’une recherche accrue de cohérence programmatique au sein de ses différents cadres d’intervention. Les équipes du Bénin, Burkina Faso, Mali, Niger, Sénégal, Tchad et Togo collaborent de manière étroite et intégrée au sein de l’espace régional SAO (Sahel Afrique de l’Ouest).

Dans ce cadre, HI met en œuvre des projets de développement et d’urgence au Togo, au Bénin et au Sénégal. Dans une dynamique de renforcement de la performance et de coordination des fonctions support, HI recherche un(e) Responsable Logistique Pays Côtiers chargé(e) de piloter et d’harmoniser les activités logistiques sur ces trois pays, dans une logique d’efficacité, de conformité et d’optimisation des ressources au service des programmes.

**Type de contrat : CDD de droit local**

**Durée du contrat : 12 mois**

**Date de prise de poste souhaitée : 01/01/2027**

**Missions :**

Sous la responsabilité directe du Responsable Logistique Régional SAO, le/la Responsable Logistique Pays Côtiers planifie, coordonne et supervise les activités logistiques au Togo, au Bénin et au Sénégal. Il/Elle veille à la performance, à la conformité et à la continuité des services logistiques, tout en développant l’harmonisation des pratiques, la coopération entre les équipes et l’optimisation des ressources à l’échelle des trois pays.

**Responsabilité 1 : Pilotage stratégique et performance logistique**

- Décliner les orientations logistiques régionales en plans d’action adaptés aux trois pays.
- Suivre la performance à travers les indicateurs, tableaux de bord et reportings, analyser les écarts et proposer des mesures correctives.
- Identifier les risques logistiques et les opportunités de mutualisation et d’optimisation des ressources.

**Responsabilité 2 : Gestion et coordination des opérations logistiques**

- Superviser les activités d’approvisionnement, d’achats, de gestion des stocks, des équipements, de la flotte, des infrastructures et des services généraux.
- Veiller à l’anticipation des besoins et à la disponibilité des ressources nécessaires à la mise en œuvre des programmes.
- Favoriser l’harmonisation des pratiques et la coordination des activités entre les trois pays.

**Responsabilité 3 : Conformité et amélioration continue**

- Veiller à l’application des procédures et standards de HI ainsi qu’au respect des exigences réglementaires et des bailleurs.
- Superviser les contrôles relevant de son périmètre et assurer le suivi des actions correctives.
- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue, à la digitalisation et à l’optimisation des processus logistiques.

**Responsabilité 4 : Management et développement des équipes**

- Manager et accompagner les responsables Approvisionnement & Achats et Services Généraux & ICT relevant de son périmètre.
- Définir les objectifs, suivre la performance et développer les compétences et l’autonomie des équipes.
- Renforcer la coopération entre les équipes des trois pays et assurer la coordination avec les interlocuteurs régionaux concernés, notamment pour les enjeux ICT.

**Responsabilité 5 : Préparation et réponse aux urgences**

- Piloter les actions de préparation logistique aux urgences sur les trois pays.
- Anticiper les besoins et identifier les ressources mobilisables pour permettre une réponse rapide et adaptée.
- Contribuer à la mobilisation et à la réorganisation des moyens logistiques en fonction des priorités opérationnelles.

**Profil du candidat**

## **Formation**

- Diplôme de niveau BAC+4 dans le domaine de la logistique , achats, commerce, approvisionnement ou équivalent.
- Une formation complémentaire ou une certification en management ou leadership est souhaitable.

## **Expérience professionnelle indispensable**

- Au moins cinq (5) ans d’expérience en tant que responsable ou coordinateur(trice) logistique et achats, avec des responsabilités significatives de pilotage.
- Expérience confirmée en management d’équipe.
- Expérience en formation, coaching ou renforcement des capacités.
- Expérience en analyse de données et en suivi de la performance à partir d’indicateurs.
- Expérience en matière de dédouanement et de procédures d’exonération fiscale, ou capacité à maîtriser rapidement les procédures applicables dans les pays concernés.

## **Expérience souhaitable**

- Expérience au sein d’une ONG internationale.
- Expérience dans un environnement multi-sites ou multi-pays.
- Expérience en coordination régionale ou fonctionnelle.
- Participation à des démarches de mutualisation, d’harmonisation ou de standardisation.

**Compétences requises:**

## **Compétences techniques et transversales**

- Bonne maîtrise des processus d’achats, d’approvisionnement, de gestion des stocks, de la flotte et des services généraux.
- Bonne capacité d’analyse des données, de suivi des indicateurs et de pilotage de la performance.
- Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques et bureautiques, notamment Excel ; la connaissance d’outils de reporting et d’analyse de données constitue un atout.
- Capacité à comprendre les enjeux multi-pays, à prioriser les besoins et à identifier les possibilités de mutualisation.
- Maîtrise du français à l’oral et à l’écrit ; la connaissance de l’anglais constitue un atout.

## **Savoir-être**

- Leadership et courage managérial, avec une capacité à responsabiliser les équipes et à accompagner leur développement.
- Excellentes capacités d’organisation, d’anticipation et de gestion des priorités.
- Esprit d’analyse, orientation résultats et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques.
- Capacités de coordination, de communication et de collaboration avec des équipes réparties sur plusieurs pays.
- Capacité à travailler sous pression et à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément.
- Intégrité, sens de l’éthique, esprit d’équipe et adhésion aux valeurs humanitaires de HI.

**Conditions salariales**

En fonction de la grille salariale de HI dans le pays de la personne retenue.

jobs.title: Supply Chain intern
jobs.description:
## Join MSF OCG as a Supply Chain intern!

**We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.**

**Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.**

This internship is part of an academic training program, a professional training program, or a socio-professional integration program, and must comply with the [conditions](https://www.ge.ch/engager-personne-stage/stages-formation-insertion-reconnus) set by the Employment Market Supervisory Council (CSME). The duration of the internship, as defined by the tripartite agreement, is 6 to 12 months at 100%

### Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF

Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?

At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.

We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.

We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

### Context & mission

Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).

The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.

To scale up to meet these operational, human resource and financial challenges, the OCG has set up a Supply Unit, with a view to optimise the management flows (goods, information and financial) and supply processes (internal and external). The final aim is to ensure a sustainable and efficient MSF Supply Chain to meet the OCG strategy.

The Supply Chain intern work in close relation with the Supply chain referent Back Office and the Supply Chain program manager on below tasks.

### Tasks & Responsibilities

- Maintain along with the Supply Referent Back office the existing reporting tools
- Participate in development, test, pilot and deployment of the Supply automated reports (Business intelligence system)
- Support the program manager in the improvement of the data management in line with the OCG supply strategy
- Help with the documentation of different data management Project
- Contribute actively to the improvement of the data quality

### Your profile

*Education*

- In progress or completed degree and specialisation in Supply chain management or Business Analytics (Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Information management)

*Languages*

- French and English with fluency in at least one of the 2 and C1 level in the other.

*Skills/ Technical competencies*

- Experience in data modelling and reporting as well as strong affinity with IT is a plus (R Studio is a plus)
- Knowledge of BI tool (Power BI preferably)

*Personal Abilities/Qualities*

- Attention to detail and structured and independent working method
- Good analytical and communication skills.
- Strong interpersonal skills, team spirit.
- Flexibility and open-mindedness

### Terms of internship

- A tripartite internship agreement is mandatory.
- 6 to 9 months, according to internship agreement.
- Full time (40h/week).
- Based in Geneva, Switzerland
- Start date : February 2027
- Gross monthly remuneration 2'000.- CHF

jobs.title: Area Manager (NES) - Raqqa
jobs.description:
About World Vision
For more than 75 years, World Vision has been committed to making a positive and lasting difference in the world. We have become a global leader in improving and transforming the lives of children, their families, and their communities. We help children, families, and communities overcome poverty and injustice, irrespective of religion, race, ethnicity, or gender. Every child deserves a life rich in meaning and purpose. We work with the most vulnerable children in the world so they can experience life in all its fullness.
Job purpose:

The Area Manager role provides strategic leadership and coordination for operational programming, serving as the principal point of contact for government, UN, and humanitarian stakeholders. The position ensures project alignment with organizational strategy, navigates complex regulatory environments, and maintains operational access and compliance. The post holder is expected to lead on the development, planning, implementation, and monitoring of programming in Northeast Syria (NES), working closely across all departments, including Technical Advisors, Grant Acquisition and Management, Finance, People and Culture, Partnerships, Security, and Program Support, to achieve high-quality results and operational excellence. The post holder is also in charge of positioning and strengthening WVSR’s engagement with governmental entities and key stakeholders in NES, ensuring an informed operational presence, and supporting the expansion and integration of program operations, as well as supporting the R&C department in registration as needed. The position will report to the Deputy Director of Field Operations.

Major Responsibilities:
PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT AND OVERSIGHT 30%
• Ensure that the portfolio of projects has sectoral alignment per the Syria Response strategy.
• Ensure assigned projects are properly planned and implemented to meet
• agreed results, timelines, and budget indicators.
• Ensure that assigned projects are adequately staffed to facilitate effective implementation.
• Facilitate reporting on the progress of field implementation.
• Analyze the effectiveness and efficiency of field implementation and introduce corrective measures where needed (key focus on managing burn rates).
• Ensure proper implementation of projects (financially and programmatically) according to WVSR standards throughout the life of the Project Cycle Management
• In collaboration with the Partnerships Manager, identify areas for staff/partner development
• Engage with partners constructively to facilitate effective partnerships on projects under the portfolio.

PROJECT PLANNING AND DESIGN 25%
• Work closely with Technical Advisors and GAM on planning and designing new proposal log frames
• Lead /support respective Project Managers in developing the project budget (DPC) during the design process

STAFF MANAGEMENT 25%
• Determine staffing requirements and facilitate hiring and orientation.
• Facilitate staff training and development.
• Set objectives for staff, monitor their performance and provide feedback.
• Ensure staff wellbeing.

LIAISON and COORDINATION 10%
• Represent World Vision Syria Response (WVSR) in NES and engage with local authorities, administrative bodies, and coordination platforms to ensure smooth operational access and compliance.
• Act as WVSR's representative in Area Coordination Groups at the sub national level, aligned with the Syria NGO Forum and UN Hubs in NES.
• Participate in relevant meetings, conferences, and cluster coordination forums by authorities, organized by authorities, UN agencies, and humanitarian actors.
• Lead high-level discussions with security forces, local councils, and government entities to facilitate approvals, resolve access issues, and maintain operational continuity.
• Prepare and submit quarterly and annual reports, project reports for each project, ensuring they are signed and stamped by relevant authorities in accordance with NES legal regulations.
• Oversee and initiate the formal registration process for WVSR with authorities yearly, ensuring compliance with local governance requirements.
• Prepare and manage all Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) between WVSR and authorities, ensuring all agreements are finalized for the project start-up.
• Ensure all correspondence with authorities adheres to WVSR policies and is documented, retained, and filed in an organized and secure manner.
• Work with authorities to secure all required authorizations and permissions for local staff movement and distributions, for project implementation, and facilitate international staff to move and cross the WVI NES office.
• Coordinate with WVSR partners to ensure proper representation of WVSR in all official documentation, including permits, MoUs, and annual reports.
• Submit regular liaison activity reports, including updates on permits, meetings held, challenges encountered, and strategic recommendations.
• Maintain a clear record of all liaison engagements, decisions, and agreements to institutional support to support institutional memory and accountability.
INTERNAL PROCESSES SUPPORT 10%
• Support the Deputy Director of Field Operations with correctly implementing established internal processes.
• Raise and highlight any discrepancies or malfunctions of internal process • design vis-à-vis the correct implementation.
• Support the revision and correction of internal processes within WVSR in coordination with other departmental functions.

Knowledge/Qualifications for the Role.

1\. Required Professional Experience
\- A minimum of 8 years of humanitarian and development experience in North East Syria.
\- Experience designing and implementing multi-sector humanitarian programs
\- Experience managing and overseeing budgets of at least $3M
\- Experience working across multiple internal departments, convening and leading people.
\- Experience with remote management and partner management
\- Strong communication skills with the ability to express ideas and concepts clearly and persuasively (oral and written) with senior members of the humanitarian community as well as with field practitioners.
\- Knowledge of computer software such as MS Office and email programs.

2\. Required Education, training, license, registration, and certification:
\- Post Graduate University degree in International Development or other related majors OR significant humanitarian leadership experience in lieu of formal education requirements.

3\. Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications
\- Comprehensive knowledge of International Human Rights Law, International Humanitarian Law, Refugee Law, the relevant positions of the UN, ICRC, and major NGOs on protection of civilians, in particular of IDPs, women, and children, the codes of conduct, the Humanitarian Charter, The Sphere Project, etc.
\- Detail-oriented, with demonstrated experience in follow-up and ensuring complex ideas turn into action.
\- Concrete, practical hands-on experience in remote management aid delivery contexts.
\- Strong knowledge of key sectoral areas, including programmatic approaches to health and protection programming.
\- Experienced and confident in external representation with donors and within formal and informal coordination structures
\- Highly developed communication skills (oral and written) with the ability to express ideas and concepts clearly and persuasively with senior internal and external stakeholders.
\- Demonstrated success as a collaborator and team builder committed to the transfer of knowledge.
\- Ability to work effectively under pressure.
\- Innovator and calculated risk taker.
\- Understands, values, and promotes diversity to achieve organizational goals.
\- Experience designing and implementing programs in Syria, through partners, is highly preferred.
\- Full adherence to World Vision Child Protection, Code of Conduct, and Conflict of Interest policies.
\- Experience in establishing, designing, and implementing cross-border programs through partners is highly preferred.

4\. Travel and/or Work Environment Requirement
\- willingness to travel domestically around NES and internationally up to 20% of the time.

5\. Language Requirements
\- Essential: Strong English and Arabic

jobs.title: Administrative and Financial Manager - Roster position
jobs.description:
**This recruitment effort aims to build a pool of team members who can be mobilized in an emergency; it is not for a specific assignment that needs to be filled immediately.**

The French Red Cross (CRF), through its International Operations Directorate (DOI) and its International Emergency Unit (PUI), contributes to the international emergency response of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

This job description is for a General Logistics Manager position within the CRF’s pool of emergency responders: the delegate may be mobilized on short notice for emergency deployments or fixed-term emergency missions in various countries and contexts.

The incumbent is responsible for the administrative, financial, and HR management of the project in the field—including accounting, cash management, management of national staff, and compliance—to ensure the smooth operation of the mission.

## Responsibilities:

Under the direct supervision of the Team Leader and the technical supervision of the Finance and HR liaisons at headquarters (DOI/PUI).

The main responsibilities and activities of the position are as follows:

### Financial Management:

- Set up administrative and financial tools and procedures at the start of the assignment: opening a petty cash fund and bank accounts, establishing fund transfer solutions, and setting up expense approval workflows.
- Maintain the assignment’s accounting records: cash journal by currency, bank journal by currency, expense documentation, and ensuring the quality of accounting documents.
- Ensure the monthly closing of the accounts and their timely submission to headquarters, including the management of exchange rates.
- Manage the mission’s cash flow: anticipate cash flow requests, make payments via the petty cash fund or bank, manage the safe, conduct regular cash counts, and reconcile cash counts with accounting records.
- Monitor the budget: track field expenditures against the budget and prepare financial reports for headquarters.
- Ensure internal control and the prevention of fraud and corruption: segregation of duties, approval workflows, compliance with spending thresholds, and procurement procedures in coordination with logistics.
- Apply donor rules and, in a coordinated effort, the Movement’s procedures (IFRC, host National Society).
- Support the Team Leader in overall budget management.

### Human Resources Management:

- Manage national human resources: local recruitment, contracts, payroll, leave, time tracking (schedules), and administrative management of staff.
- Integrate safeguarding requirements into HR management: conduct background checks during recruitment, ensure signing of the Code of Conduct, and raise awareness among national staff regarding PEAS/PSEA.
- Ensure the mission’s administrative and legal compliance (taxation, local labor law, registrations) in coordination with the host national company.
- Organize the team’s work: regular meetings, clear objectives and deadlines, monitoring, and support.

### Administrative management of the mission:

- Manage the administrative aspects of deployments: mission orders, per diem.
- Oversee support services (field camp) and ensure a work environment that complies with the Movement’s rules.
- Ensure the archiving of administrative and financial documents and the handover at the end of the mission.

## Skills

### Skills Specific to the Movement

- Adherence to the Fundamental Principles and knowledge of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.
- Proficiency in office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and collaborative platforms.

### Skills Specific to the Position

- Accounting and cash management.
- HR management and payroll.
- Knowledge of labor law in an international context.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Excel (advanced level).
- Ability to negotiate in emergency situations.
- Attention to detail, discretion, and respect for confidentiality; ability to work under pressure and as part of a small team (field camp).

### Language Skills

- An excellent command of English is required (spoken and written).
- Fluency in French is a major asset; fluency in another official language of the IFRC (Spanish or Arabic) is preferred.

## **Profil**

- A bachelor’s or master’s degree in management, accounting, finance, human resources, or administration.
- Proven experience in the administrative and financial management of emergency humanitarian projects, including at least two years on an international humanitarian mission.
- Previous experience within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement is a major asset.

jobs.title: Venezuela: Auxiliar de Plataforma de Gestión Monday (Caracas)
jobs.description:
La Cruz Roja Venezolana (CRV) es una organización humanitaria cuyo mandato es salvar vidas y mejorar las condiciones de las personas en situación de vulnerabilidad. Como parte del Movimiento Internacional de la Cruz Roja y la Media Luna Roja, brinda asistencia oportuna en emergencias, desastres y contextos de necesidad humanitaria.

Guiada por sus Principios Fundamentales—Humanidad, Imparcialidad, Neutralidad, Independencia, Voluntariado, Unidad y Universalidad—la CRV actúa como auxiliar de los poderes públicos en el ámbito humanitario, trabajando para reducir el sufrimiento humano sin distinción de raza, género, religión o ideología. Su labor abarca la atención médica de emergencia, el fortalecimiento de la resiliencia comunitaria, la capacitación en primeros auxilios, la respuesta a desastres y la promoción de la salud y el bienestar.

A través de una red de voluntarios altamente comprometidos, la CRV moviliza recursos de manera eficiente y eficaz para estar presente donde más se necesita, cuando más se necesita. Su labor se fundamenta en la solidaridad, el respeto a la dignidad humana y el compromiso con la protección de la vida en todas sus formas.

**Compromiso con la Salvaguarda**

La Cruz Roja Venezolana está comprometida con la creación y mantenimiento de entornos seguros y respetuosos para las comunidades, el personal y el voluntariado y con la prevención de la explotación, el abuso y el acoso sexual.

Las personas seleccionadas deberán cumplir el Código de Conducta y las políticas y estándares de Salvaguarda aplicables. Como parte de su proceso de contratación segura, la CRV podrá realizar verificaciones de referencias profesionales y solicitar información pertinente sobre antecedentes de conducta profesional y Salvaguarda, de acuerdo con sus procedimientos y la normativa aplicable.

**Responsabilidad general de Salvaguarda**

La persona titular del puesto deberá promover y respetar los estándares de Salvaguarda de la Cruz Roja Venezolana, cumplir el Código de Conducta y las políticas aplicables, mantener límites profesionales apropiados, contribuir a prevenir daños y reportar de forma inmediata cualquier preocupación de Salvaguarda a través de los mecanismos establecidos.

**Adición para puestos de riesgo elevado**

Debido a la naturaleza de sus funciones, la persona deberá identificar y mitigar activamente riesgos de Salvaguarda asociados a sus actividades, mantener estándares reforzados de conducta y límites profesionales y asegurar que su interacción con comunidades y personas en situación de vulnerabilidad se desarrolle de forma segura, digna, inclusiva y respetuosa.

Si deseas formar parte del equipo y hacer la diferencia, te invitamos a sumarte.

*¿Cómo puedes hacer la diferencia? Funciones claves / Responsabilidades*

La persona seleccionada será la responsable técnica de la plataforma de gestión operativa dentro de la CRV, encargada de administrar, ordenar y desarrollar el sistema para que los equipos registren, coordinen y reporten su trabajo de forma confiable y oportuna, facilitando la toma de decisiones estratégicas.

Será el/la encargado(a) de:

- Administrar usuarios, equipos, permisos, accesos y normas de uso (nomenclatura, criterios de espacios y tableros, archivo de inactivos).
- Depurar y estandarizar la estructura existente de la cuenta (tableros, columnas, listas de valores, automatizaciones) para asegurar la calidad de los datos.
- Levantar requerimientos operativos y desarrollar soluciones digitales sencillas y efectivas: tableros, formularios, vistas, automatizaciones y flujos de aprobación.
- Dar seguimiento técnico y estabilidad a las integraciones con otros sistemas institucionales (en especial WaWa, Sistock y herramientas de recolección de datos o correo).
- Diseñar y mantener paneles consolidados de actividades, beneficiarios, voluntariado e indicadores clave para la Dirección y los reportes situacionales (SITREPs).
- Acompañar, formar y brindar soporte continuo a las personas usuarias en Sede Central, equipos de terreno y filiales.
- Documentar la arquitectura de la cuenta, flujos, automatizaciones e integraciones para garantizar la sostenibilidad y continuidad del sistema.
- Diseñar la hoja de ruta para la extensión progresiva de la plataforma a toda la operación institucional (programas, áreas de apoyo, gobierno y filiales).
- Otras funciones afines asignadas por la supervisión directa.

Reporte

El/La Administrador/a y desarrollador/a de la plataforma le reportará a la Dirección de Desarrollo Organizacional / Dirección General.

Lugar de trabajo

Caracas (Sede Central).

Para calificar como un constructor del sistema humanitario venezolano deberás cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:

- Título universitario o técnico superior en ingeniería de sistemas, informática, ingeniería industrial, administración, estadística, gestión de la información o áreas afines (o experiencia equivalente demostrable).
- Mínimo de dos (2) años de experiencia configurando o administrando herramientas digitales de gestión de trabajo, procesos o datos (Asana, ClickUp, Airtable, Notion, Jira, Google Workspace avanzado, etc.).
- Experiencia demostrable en la traducción de procesos operativos en flujos de trabajo, formularios y bases de datos funcionales.
- Dominio técnico de hojas de cálculo (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas, limpieza de datos) y comprensión del modelado relacional de datos.
- Conocimientos conceptuales y prácticos sobre integraciones entre sistemas (API, webhooks, conectores o servicios de integración).
- Capacidad analítica, pensamiento sistémico, organización y habilidad para comunicar conceptos técnicos a equipos no técnicos.
- Disponibilidad para trabajar en contextos de emergencia e imprevisibilidad operativa.
- Fluidez en español; conocimientos de inglés técnico son deseables.
- Compromiso firme con los Principios Fundamentales del Movimiento Internacional de la Cruz Roja y de la Media Luna Roja y confidencialidad en el manejo de datos.

jobs.title: Venezuela: Líder de Proyecto (Caracas)
jobs.description:
La Cruz Roja Venezolana (CRV) es una organización humanitaria cuyo mandato es salvar vidas y mejorar las condiciones de las personas en situación de vulnerabilidad. Como parte del Movimiento Internacional de la Cruz Roja y la Media Luna Roja, brinda asistencia oportuna en emergencias, desastres y contextos de necesidad humanitaria.

Guiada por sus Principios Fundamentales—Humanidad, Imparcialidad, Neutralidad, Independencia, Voluntariado, Unidad y Universalidad—la CRV actúa como auxiliar de los poderes públicos en el ámbito humanitario, trabajando para reducir el sufrimiento humano sin distinción de raza, género, religión o ideología. Su labor abarca la atención médica de emergencia, el fortalecimiento de la resiliencia comunitaria, la capacitación en primeros auxilios, la respuesta a desastres y la promoción de la salud y el bienestar.

A través de una red de voluntarios altamente comprometidos, la CRV moviliza recursos de manera eficiente y eficaz para estar presente donde más se necesita, cuando más se necesita. Su labor se fundamenta en la solidaridad, el respeto a la dignidad humana y el compromiso con la protección de la vida en todas sus formas.

**Compromiso con la Salvaguarda**

La Cruz Roja Venezolana está comprometida con la creación y mantenimiento de entornos seguros y respetuosos para las comunidades, el personal y el voluntariado y con la prevención de la explotación, el abuso y el acoso sexual.

Las personas seleccionadas deberán cumplir el Código de Conducta y las políticas y estándares de Salvaguarda aplicables. Como parte de su proceso de contratación segura, la CRV podrá realizar verificaciones de referencias profesionales y solicitar información pertinente sobre antecedentes de conducta profesional y Salvaguarda, de acuerdo con sus procedimientos y la normativa aplicable.

**Responsabilidad general de Salvaguarda**

La persona titular del puesto deberá promover y respetar los estándares de Salvaguarda de la Cruz Roja Venezolana, cumplir el Código de Conducta y las políticas aplicables, mantener límites profesionales apropiados, contribuir a prevenir daños y reportar de forma inmediata cualquier preocupación de Salvaguarda a través de los mecanismos establecidos.

**Adición para puestos de riesgo elevado**

Debido a la naturaleza de sus funciones, la persona deberá identificar y mitigar activamente riesgos de Salvaguarda asociados a sus actividades, mantener estándares reforzados de conducta y límites profesionales y asegurar que su interacción con comunidades y personas en situación de vulnerabilidad se desarrolle de forma segura, digna, inclusiva y respetuosa.

Si deseas formar parte del equipo y hacer la diferencia, te invitamos a sumarte.

Por favor verifique que cumpla con todos o la mayoría de los requisitos para aplicar.

*¿Cómo puedes hacer la diferencia? Funciones claves / Responsabilidades*

El/La Líder de proyecto tendrá como responsabilidad principal garantizar la implementación integral del proyecto, mediante la coordinación técnica y administrativa de las actividades ejecutadas en las filiales correspondientes. Esto incluye la selección adecuada de comunidades beneficiarias, supervisión de actividades comunitarias y atenciones médicas, monitoreo y seguimiento de indicadores, aseguramiento de la correcta ejecución presupuestaria y recolección de fuentes de verificación. Además, el gerente de proyectos actuará como enlace entre la Cruz Roja Venezolana y las distintas organizaciones aliadas, siendo responsable de la elaboración de informes mensuales y contribuyendo a los reportes requeridos por el socio donante, así como de promover alianzas estratégicas y fortalecer las capacidades locales a través de capacitaciones y actividades educativas.

Será el/la encargado(a) de:

- Supervisar la implementación del proyecto en los puntos de atención, asegurando que se cumplan los objetivos y plazos establecidos según los lineamientos de la Cruz Roja Venezolana y aliados.
- Coordinar la selección de comunidades beneficiarias asegurando el cumplimiento de los criterios establecidos en el proyecto.
- Coordinar y gestionar los recursos humanos, financieros y materiales necesarios para la ejecución del proyecto.
- Coordinar y trabajar en conjunto con los Coordinadores Locales y los equipos asignados al proyecto para asegurar la implementación efectiva de atenciones médicas, actividades comunitarias y generación de reportes.
- Implementar sistemas de monitoreo y evaluación para medir el progreso y el impacto del proyecto.
- Garantizar la coordinación, programación y supervisión de actividades comunitarias en las filiales participantes.
- Realizar visitas de campo regulares para supervisar las actividades del proyecto y asegurar la calidad de la implementación.
- Asegurar la correcta recolección, transcripción y análisis de información de las actividades realizadas.
- Llevar control activo de las fuentes de verificación de actividades, incluyendo el registro fotográfico y documental.
- Elaborar reportes detallados sobre las actividades del proyecto, incluyendo un informe mensual conforme a los formatos establecidos.
- Supervisar la gestión financiera del proyecto, incluyendo la elaboración de presupuestos, seguimiento de gastos y preparación de informes financieros.
- Asegurar el cumplimiento de las políticas y procedimientos financieros de la organización y gestionar las relaciones con los donantes previa autorización de la dirección de programas.
- Apoyar la identificación de centros ambulatorios que requieran mejoras en sistemas de agua y saneamiento, en coordinación con el asistente WASH contratado.
- Supervisar las obras y asegurar su alineación con los estándares técnicos y objetivos del proyecto.
- Respetar y hacer cumplir las normativas de visibilidad y difusión establecidas por la Cruz Roja Venezolana.
- Coordinar, junto con voluntarios y equipos locales, sesiones educativas de promoción y prevención en salud y agua saneamiento e higiene.
- Asegurar la visibilidad del proyecto a través de la comunicación efectiva con las partes interesadas y la comunidad.
- Establecer y fortalecer alianzas estratégicas con otras organizaciones humanitarias para facilitar el acceso de los pacientes a los servicios de salud de la Cruz Roja Venezolana.
- Desarrollar y mantener relaciones con socios, autoridades locales y otras organizaciones relevantes.
- Asegurar que el proyecto cumpla con los estándares de calidad y las políticas de la Cruz Roja Venezolana.
- Implementar medidas correctivas cuando sea necesario para mejorar la calidad del proyecto.
- Coordinar con otros departamentos de la Cruz Roja Venezolana y con socios del Movimiento de la Cruz Roja y la Media Luna Roja.
- Facilitar la colaboración y el intercambio de conocimientos entre los diferentes equipos y proyectos.
- Garantizar la confidencialidad de la información del proyecto, incluyendo datos presupuestarios.
- Realizar otras tareas relacionadas con el tipo de puesto y las asignadas por su superior inmediato, en función de las características y condiciones especiales del puesto, para brindar un servicio de calidad que cumpla con las metas y objetivos de la institución, de acuerdo con el Plan Estratégico de Desarrollo de la Sociedad Nacional.

*Reporte*

El/La Líder de proyecto le reportará a la Dirección de Programas.

*Viajes*

Debe tener disponibilidad para viajar por el país.

*Equipos*

Es altamente deseable que cuente con equipos suficientes para el desempeño de su función de manera remota: laptop y/o computadora, buena conexión a Internet, entre otros.

*Lugar de trabajo*

Caracas (Sede central de la Cruz Roja Venezolana).

*Para calificar como un constructor del sistema humanitario venezolano deberás cumplir con los siguientes requisitos:*

- Grado universitario en un campo relevante al proyecto como: estudios internacionales, salud pública, ingeniería industrial, administración de empresas. Un grado universitario de primer nivel en combinación con cinco (5) años de experiencia laboral será aceptado como un grado universitario avanzado.
- Se requiere un mínimo de cinco (5) años de experiencia profesional en el diseño, implementación y gestión de programas y proyectos humanitarios, preferiblemente con un enfoque en Salud Comunitaria, Atención Primaria de Salud y Respuesta de Riesgos a Desastres.
- Fuertes habilidades de gestión de programas, incluyendo planificación, seguimiento de actividades, gestión financiera, monitoreo y evaluación.
- Antecedentes técnicos en una o más de las siguientes áreas: Salud, Respuesta de Riesgos a Desastres, Migración, Finanzas y Logística es una ventaja.
- Experiencia en la gestión de proyectos financiados por donantes internacionales, es requerido.
- Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de redacción, capaces de fomentar y mantener alianzas.
- Experiencia en trabajo con organizaciones locales, para impulsar su fortalecimiento.
- Capacidad para capacitar y guiar al personal y voluntarios, para proporcionar apoyo técnico y fortalecimiento de capacidades.
- Experiencia en facilitar procesos de desarrollo organizacional es deseable.
- Experiencia trabajando con el Movimiento de la Cruz Roja / Media Luna Roja es deseable.
- Fluidez oral y escrita en español e inglés es un requisito.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, capacidad para construir relaciones a todos los niveles.
- Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y como miembro de un equipo.
- Capacidad y acuerdo para adherirse a los Principios Fundamentales de la Cruz Roja y la Media Luna Roja.
- Preferiblemente experiencia laboral en contextos de emergencia con gestión de voluntarios.
- Capacidad de mantener la confidencialidad.

jobs.title: X-ray technician
jobs.description:
***IDA is an international independent non-governmental organization providing medical and humanitarian assistance to people affected by conflicts, natural disasters and epidemics regardless of race, religion, gender or political affiliation.***
***IDA was founded in 2012 by Syrian doctors from Aleppo in response to the healthcare and humanitarian crisis in Syria.***

***IDA Syria is the main healthcare provider in the Northern Aleppo/Syria area, working closely with 500,000 IDPs and 700,000 host communities through 20 healthcare facilities and other health and nutrition projects***

***During last year, IDA has provided 1.2 million services in Heath, Nutrition, WaSH and Camp Management***

***Specific Responsibilities:***

-Provide high quality services (as an X-Ray Technician) 8 hours per day, 6 days per week and coordinate with the Medical Manager according to the agreed roster
-Provide the needed X-Ray services for patients according to the guidelines including proper preparation of patients and the X-Ray machine.
-Assist patients before, during, and after the process.
-Prepare X-Ray films after finishing the X-Ray process in order to develop them and approve their validity.
-Show X-Ray films after developing them to the doctor in charge to read them and write the final report.
-Use mobile devices to do X-Ray to patients whose conditions don’t allow them to be sent to the X-Ray Room.
-Prepare materials such as catheters, injections, medications...etc. for the doctors to make the needed tests and examinations.
-Assist the doctor in completing important tests and examinations.
-Receive films and materials, match, count, and keep them in a proper place to prevent damage.
-Receive medications, coats, X-Ray materials …etc. and keep them in X-Ray Room.
-Preserve the safety of the devices and equipment and avoid misusing them by applying the instructions of the manufacturing company.
-Constant checking on X-Ray machine in order to ensure its status and report any existing problems as well as doing the follow up for any maintenance or preventive programs.
-Apply general safety rules and protection from radiation at work.
-Do other duties -within his/her experiences- assigned by the X-Ray Doctor, the Medical Coordinator or the Medical Coordinator Assistant.
• Strictly adhere to humanitarian and protection principles and standards, as well as organizational policies including the Code of Conduct, Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) and Child Protection

- **Qualifications:**
- **Context/Specific skills, knowledge, and experience:**
-Academic Certificate or equivalent in X-Ray.
-Minimum three years of experience as an X-Ray Technician in hospitals
-Computer skills (Office Microsoft)
- ***Independent Doctors Association does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, and committed to acting professionally and ethically.***
***Independent Doctors Association is zero tolerable with any SEA case, IDA is creating the best environment to make sure that all staff have understood SEA and how to report in case there is any suspected case***

## INSTRUCTION TO BIDDERS

### 1. Description of the Procurement

WUSC intends to procure a “Development of A Safeguarding and Women At Work Protection Policy for the Vocational Training Corporation (VTC) **Consultant”** as per the Terms of Reference attached in Annex 1.

### 2. Eligibility and Qualification of Bidders

2.1 In order to be awarded the contract, bidders should possess the financial, economic, technical, and professional capacity to perform the contract. Bidders should fulfill their tax and social insurance liabilities in the country and should not currently be subject to a debarment penalty.

2.2 Bidders must adhere to the highest ethical standards, both throughout the bidding process and execution of the contract.

2.3 WUSC has a zero tolerance for unethical behavior/corrupt practices, including:

o Bribery: the act of unduly offering, giving, receiving or soliciting anything of value to influence the procurement process;

o Extortion or coercion: the act of attempting to influence the process of procuring goods or services, or executing contracts by means of threats of injury to person, property or reputation;

o Fraud: misrepresentation of information or facts for the purpose of influencing the procurement process;

o Collusion: an agreement between bidders designed to result in bids at artificial prices that are not competitive;

o Guilt of misrepresentation in supplying the information required by the contracting authority as a condition of participation in the contract procedure or failing to supply this information;

o Anti-terrorism: support of any terrorist or terrorist group as defined by donors;

o Other civil, criminal acts or otherwise illegal activity which would be detrimental to the financial interests of WUSC

2.4 WUSC may declare the consultancy firms, their boards of directors and/or individual personnel ineligible to register with the organization either indefinitely or for a stated period of time.

2.5 WUSC will reject a proposal if it establishes that the bidder recommended for award has engaged in corrupt, fraudulent, collusive or coercive practices in competing for the contract.

2.6 Freelance consultants are eligible for this RFP (Local bidders only – Located in Jordan)

### 3. Language of the Proposal

### 4. Documents included in the Proposal

The proposal will be prepared, submitted, and evaluated in two parts as follows:

4.1 **Technical Proposal Format and Content**

The Technical Proposal shall be prepared using the consultant/ firm’s format and shall comprise the documents listed\*\*.\*\* The Technical Proposal shall not include any financial information. A Technical Proposal containing material financial information shall be declared non-responsive.

**Section 1** (In case of an open tender where the suppliers are not known to WUSC; the following documents should be requested) for eligibility and compliance check/evaluation

o Covering letter on firms headed paper giving complete details including email addresses, telephone contacts, office location where applicable; not required for freelance bidders.

o Copy of Certificate of incorporation/registration **(Commercial registration)** where applicable; not required for freelance bidders.

o Valid Tax compliance certificate (where applicable)

o Copy of Current Trading License **(Vocational license)** where applicable; not required for freelance bidders.

Failure to submit the documents requested in section 1 will lead to rejection of the proposal.

4.2 **Financial Proposal format and content**

The Financial Proposal shall be prepared using the consultant/firm’s format, and it shall list all costs associated with the assignment, including (a) remuneration for Key Experts and Non-Key Experts, (b) reimbursable expenses as follows:

o Summary of Costs

o Breakdown of Remuneration of the key experts proposed

o Reimbursable expenses if any

4.2.1 The prices given in the financial proposal must include all taxes and duties in accordance with the laws of the country.

4.2.2 The price offered must remain fixed during the contract performance.

4.2.3 The bid price must be in the requested Currency, which is *Jordanian Dinar (JOD).*

The response will be distributed to all bidders without identifying the source of the request. All enquiries should be written to WUSC through (procurement.jo@wusc.ca)*.*

### 6. Modification and Withdrawal

6.1 The bidder may submit a modified bid or a modification to any part of it at any time prior to the proposal submission deadline. The bidder’s withdrawal notice must be marked as “Modification”. No modifications to the bid shall be accepted after the deadline.

6.2 The bidder may submit a bid withdrawal notice to any part of it at any time prior to the proposal submission deadline. The bidder’s withdrawal notice must be marked as “Withdrawal”. No withdrawals to the bid shall be accepted after the deadline.

### 7. Payment and Currency

7.2 Payment will be made within 30 days upon submission of the invoice and satisfactory receipt of goods/services.

8.2 The original Technical Proposal shall be clearly marked “TECHNICAL PROPOSAL” and the title of the attachment.

8.3 The original Financial Proposal shall be clearly marked “FINANCIAL PROPOSAL” as the title of the attachment. **(Note: Technical and financial proposals must be submitted in one email with separate attachments).**

Proposals submitted must be valid for 90 days from the bid submission date.

### 10. Bid Opening

10.1 WUSC evaluation committee shall conduct the opening of the proposals immediately after the bid submission time.The opening date will be 19 November 2026.

10.2 At the opening of the proposals, only the Technical proposal shall be opened while Financial Proposal shall remain at the procurement department and shall be securely stored. bids the following shall be read out: (i) the name and the country of the bidder (ii) any modifications to the bid submitted prior to the proposal submission deadline, (iii) any other information deemed appropriate. This information will be filled in the bid opening form.

### 11. Evaluation of Technical Proposals

11.1 The evaluators of the Technical Proposals shall have no access to the Financial Proposals until the technical evaluation is concluded.

11.2 The tender committee shall evaluate the Technical Proposals on the basis of their responsiveness to the Terms of Reference and the RFP, applying the evaluation criteria, sub-criteria, and point system specified below. Each responsive Proposal will be given a technical score.

A Proposal shall be rejected at this stage if it does not respond to important aspects of the RFP or if it fails to achieve the minimum technical score.

During evaluation of bids, WUSC may request the bidder, in writing, using mailing address or email address, to provide clarification of his bid. No change in price or substance of the bid shall be sought, offered or permitted.

**Proposal Evaluation Criteria**

Criteria, sub-criteria, and point system for the evaluation of the Technical Proposals:

1\. Technical (which includes: Relevance of education and experience in conducting similar assignments and trainings, Experience in working with public institutions and government and INGOs , Experience in, conducting training sessions. Experiance of National policies and regulation assessment (70 points)

2\. Financial Proposal (30 points)

**Total points for the four criteria**\*\*\*:\*\*\* **100**

**The minimum technical score (St) required to pass is: 65**

**The minimum Overall score: 70**

### 12. Evaluation of Financial Proposals

12.1 The Financial Proposals of the bidders who attain the minimum technical scores are opened and the summary of cost prices read out and recorded in the bid opening form by the tender committee. All other Financial Proposals are returned unopened after the Contract negotiations are successfully concluded and the Contract is signed.

12.2 Arithmetical errors will be rectified in the following manner. If there is a discrepancy between the unit price and the total price, obtained in multiplying the unit price by quantity, the unit price will prevail. If there is a discrepancy between the words and figures, the amount in words shall prevail. If the bidder disagrees with such his bid will be rejected.

**Proposal Evaluation Criteria**

**The formula for determining the financial scores (Sf) of all other Proposals is calculated as follows:**

**Burden of Childcare Reduced and Addressed for Women in Jordan (BUCRA)**

**Call for Consultant(s): DEVELOPMENT OF A SAFEGUARDING AND WOMEN AT WORK PROTECTION POLICY FOR THE VOCATIONAL TRAINING CORPORATION (VTC) Consultant**

**Terms of Reference**

**RFP\\JOR\\2026\\741**

**BACKGROUND:**

Burden of Childcare Reduced and Addressed for Women in Jordan (BUCRA - meaning Tomorrow in Arabic) is a 5-year initiative (2024-2029) funded by Global Affairs Canada and designed to enhance the economic empowerment of women in Jordan. BUCRA takes a system approach that engages and supports local stakeholders from government, training bodies, the private sector and communities to drive gender-transformative change that addresses the most pressing childcare issues preventing women from participating and remaining in the workforce in Jordan. BUCRA targets over 8,600 women in 7 regions. The approach of equipping key stakeholders to address systemic barriers will enable the impacts to be experienced by women throughout Jordan over the long term.

BUCRA is implemented in partnership with several local implementing partners including relevant government agencies, the Vocational Training Corporation (VTC) and the National Council of Family Affairs (NCFA) and civil society organization (Rayat Alyawm) under the umbrella of the Ministry of Social Development (MoSD). WUSC and partners will deliver under five key outcome areas: i) enhance the capacity of training providers to provide quality, market-relevant, and inclusive Early Childhood Care and Development (ECCD) training; ii) increase access by women to ECCD-related services to secure employment or start/expand their home-based nurseries; iii) improve capacity of key stakeholders to develop and implement gender-responsive policy and regulation fostering the availability of quality ECCD services; iv) improve attitudes among women and their communities about women's work and ECCD; and v) enhance the capacity of ECCD employers to provide quality, gender-responsive and inclusive ECCD services.

**Context:**

VTC is one of BUCRA’s key partners in the project’s efforts to strengthen the capacity of training providers to deliver quality, market-relevant, gender-transformative, and inclusive Early Childhood Care and Development (ECCD) training. As a training institution, VTC plays an important role in promoting safe, inclusive, and gender-responsive learning and working environments through its existing gender unit.

Within the framework of BUCRA’s Year 3 Annual Work Plan, there is a need to provide technical support to the Vocational Training Corporation (VTC) on safeguarding and gender-based violence (GBV), with the aim of fostering a safe and inclusive training and working environment for all employees, free from violence, harassment, and discrimination, and ensuring the protection of their rights and dignity and equal opportunities. This support will include a systematic review of VTC’s existing institutional documents and practices related to safeguarding, GBV, workplace protection, complaints mechanisms, human resources (HR), codes of conduct, reporting, and referral mechanisms. The review will assess both formal policies and procedures and the extent to which existing institutional mechanisms are implemented and function effectively in practice. It will also build on the findings of the previous institutional audit to identify gaps, avoid duplication, and inform the development or updating of relevant institutional documents, alongside targeted capacity-building activities to strengthen VTC’s institutional capacity to prevent and respond to safeguarding concerns and GBV.

**Purpose:**

The purpose of this consultancy is to provide technical assistance to the Vocational Training Corporation (VTC) to review its existing safeguarding, Gender-Based Violence (GBV), and related institutional documents and develop a comprehensive Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy, supported by practical recommendations and capacity-strengthening measures.

The consultancy aims to strengthen VTC’s institutional capacity and systems to prevent, identify, report, and respond to safeguarding concerns, GBV, harassment, discrimination, and other protection-related risks affecting all staff and learners in both the workplace and learning environments.

The assignment will follow a participatory and consultative approach, engaging relevant VTC stakeholders to ensure that the policy is context-specific, aligned with VTC’s institutional mandate and existing mechanisms, and clearly defines roles, responsibilities, reporting procedures, and response measures

**Scope of Work:**

- **Review and map** all existing VTC policies, procedures, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, HR mechanisms, complaints and reporting mechanisms, safeguarding/GBV-related documents, referral pathways, and other relevant institutional mechanisms. The review should also consider relevant findings and recommendations from the previous VTC institutional audit and assess how existing mechanisms are currently applied in practice, where information is available. The review may also consider existing policies and procedures from other Jordanian institutions and governmental bodies, where lessons learned could be relevant to the VTC.
- **Conduct a safeguarding and GBV institutional gap analysis** based on the document review, previous institutional audit findings, relevant national requirements/frameworks, and applicable good practices. The analysis should identify what mechanisms currently exist, what is missing or insufficient, areas of overlap or inconsistency, implementation gaps, and priority areas requiring strengthening. This gap analysis should specifically use an intersectional lens to understand how diverse groups of employees (women, men, persons with disabilities, and other minorities) are able to benefit or are excluded from existing policies and practices.
- **Facilitate a validation session** to ensure that the findings of the gap analysis correspond to the VTC’s understanding. This step will ensure that the analysis does not have any gaps, and that there is buy-in for overarching policy direction before a draft is presented to VTC management.
- **Develop a draft Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy** tailored to VTC’s institutional and vocational training context, covering prevention, reporting and complaints mechanisms, referral and response procedures, confidentiality, roles and responsibilities, and protection from GBV and other safeguarding concerns.
- **Facilitate a second validation session** with relevant VTC staff to review the draft policy, validate the findings and proposed mechanisms, identify any remaining gaps or implementation considerations, and agree on revisions required before finalization.
- **Finalize the Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy**, incorporating VTC’ s feedback and providing practical recommendations for implementation, institutionalization, and follow-up within VTC.
- **Design and deliver practical safeguarding and GBV training of trainers** for relevant VTC staff and other identified focal points. The training should introduce the finalized policy and strengthen participants’ understanding of safeguarding principles, prevention, identification and reporting of concerns, complaints and reporting mechanisms, referral and response procedures, confidentiality, protection from retaliation, roles and responsibilities, and practical application of the policy within VTC. This training should give staff and focal points the tools, materials and knowledge needed to support dissemination of the policy throughout the organization, as well as to conduct regular refresher trainings, after the conclusion of this consultancy
- **Final Consultancy Report and Recommendations:** Submission of a comprehensive final report outlining the consultancy process, key findings, developed policy, and practical recommendations for institutional strengthening and implementation.

**DELIVERABLES:**

- \*\*Inception Report and Review Methodology :\*\*Detailed inception plan outlining the proposed methodology, document review approach, analytical framework, consultation process, key stakeholders, assessment tools, and proposed timeline.
- **Safeguarding and GBV Gap Analysis:** Safeguarding and GBV gap analysis findings built on identifying existing mechanisms, identifying gaps, overlaps, inconsistencies, implementation challenges, and priority areas for improvement, based on relevant national requirements and applicable good practices.
- **Safeguarding and GBV Gap Analysis Validation Session**: Develop session materials or presentations and facilitate a discussion to ensure that VTC staff and management are in agreement with the gap analysis findings.
- **Draft Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy:** Draft Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy tailored to VTC’s institutional and vocational training context including practical recommendations for strengthening existing institutional mechanisms and addressing the priority gaps identified through the review and gap analysis.
- **To facilitate a validation Session:** Validation session with relevant VTC staff, including the Gender Unit, to present and review the draft policy, gather feedback, clarify institutional roles and implementation requirements, and identify necessary revisions.
- \*\*Final Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy :\*\*Final Safeguarding and Women at Work Protection Policy incorporating feedback from WUSC and relevant VTC staff following the validation session.
- **Safeguarding and GBV Capacity- Strengthening Training of Trainers:** Practical safeguarding and GBV training for relevant VTC staff to introduce the finalized policy , covering safeguarding principles, prevention, identification and reporting of concerns, complaints mechanisms, referral procedures, confidentiality, and staff roles and responsibilities and other concerns. The consultant is responsible for designing the training materials and supporting resources to facilitate the application of the knowledge and practices introduced during the training.
- **Final Consultancy Report and Recommendations:** A comprehensive report documenting the review process, key findings of the safeguarding and GBV gap analysis, assessment of existing institutional mechanisms, identified gaps and priority areas for improvement, and capacity-building activities delivered. In addition to clear and actionable, evidence-based practical recommendations for strengthening VTC’s safeguarding and GBV prevention and response mechanisms, including practical recommendations for policy implementation, institutionalization, monitoring, and follow-up.

***Note: WUSC will be responsible for the orientation session costs- (Logistics, Venue, etc..)***

***The Policy and all related training materials shall be developed and submitted in Arabic. WUSC will be responsible for translating the Policy into English. The Consultant shall proofread and validate the English translation to ensure its accuracy, consistency with the original Arabic version, and technical appropriateness, and provide final approval of the translated version.***
